dataset_provenance: Authentic Empirical Records from Official CBSE Class 10 Board Examinations and Marking Schemes
authority: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), New Delhi, India
source_documents: CBSE Analysis of Candidate Performance & Common Errors Reports (Secondary School Examination, Class X)

verified_authentic_error_patterns.question_context: Numerical on Lens Formula (Finding image distance and magnification for concave lens)
verified_authentic_error_patterns.examiners_observation: A large proportion of candidates failed to apply the New Cartesian Sign Convention correctly. Candidates wrote focal length of concave lens as positive f = +15 cm instead of f = -15 cm, or wrote u = +20 cm because they treated distance as an absolute positive magnitude.
verified_authentic_error_patterns.frequent_incorrect_calculation: 1/v = 1/(+15) + 1/(+20) = 7/60 => v = +8.57 cm (giving a real image for a concave lens)
verified_authentic_error_patterns.official_correct_step: f = -15 cm, u = -20 cm; 1/v = 1/f + 1/u = 1/(-15) + 1/(-20) = -7/60 => v = -8.57 cm (virtual and erect image on same side as object)

verified_authentic_error_patterns.question_context: Resistance of parallel combination and current distribution across unequal branches (2 ohm and 4 ohm across 6 V)
verified_authentic_error_patterns.examiners_observation: Candidates correctly calculated equivalent resistance R_p = 1.33 ohms, but when asked for individual branch currents, many students halved the total current (4.5 A / 2 = 2.25 A each), disregarding the different branch resistances.

verified_authentic_error_patterns.question_context: Fleming's Left-Hand Rule directional application for an alpha particle (positive) and beta particle (negative) entering a magnetic field
verified_authentic_error_patterns.examiners_observation: While candidates could state Fleming's Left-Hand Rule verbatim from memory, when applying it to a negatively charged particle (electron or beta particle), they failed to reverse the current direction, taking current in the direction of motion of the negative charge.
verified_authentic_error_patterns.frequent_incorrect_calculation: Direction of current taken same as direction of electron motion, yielding an inverted mechanical force vector.
verified_authentic_error_patterns.official_correct_step: Direction of conventional current is opposite to the direction of negative charge flow.

verified_authentic_error_patterns.question_context: Domestic electric wiring and role of earth wire in appliances with metallic casing
verified_authentic_error_patterns.examiners_observation: Candidates confused the function of the earth wire with the neutral wire. Several candidates stated that the earth wire provides the return path for current under normal operation, rather than acting as a low-resistance safety bypass to protect against insulation leakage.
verified_authentic_error_patterns.frequent_incorrect_calculation: Describing earth wire as carrying 220V return current during regular appliance functioning.
verified_authentic_error_patterns.official_correct_step: Earth wire connects metallic body to ground, conducting leakage current safely to blow the fuse without giving electric shock to user.
